Speech translation (ST), the task of translating acoustic speech signals into text in a foreign language ...

Speech translation (ST), the task of translating acoustic speech signals into text in a foreign language, is a complex and multi-faceted task that builds upon work in automatic speech recognition (ASR) and machine translation (MT).
Several of the application-specific requirements demand user studies and will not be sufficiently solved by relying on automatic metrics only.
